name: Vercel Sandbox
description: Runs untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Firecracker microVMs on Vercel, with snapshots, persistent sandboxes, and custom images, via TypeScript and Python SDKs and a CLI.

skills.name: Isolated MicroVMs
skills.description: Runs each sandbox in a Firecracker microVM with its own filesystem and network.

skills.name: Snapshotting
skills.description: Saves a running sandbox's state so later runs resume without reinstalling dependencies.

skills.name: Persistent Sandboxes
skills.description: Auto-saves sandbox state on stop and resumes where it left off by default.

skills.name: Managed and Custom Images
skills.description: Starts sandboxes from Vercel managed images or your own OCI images in Vercel Container Registry.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Isolation
skills.description: Gives each agent its own Linux user and home directory and shares files between agents with groups.
